I.value_zh: SOP、release checklist、12类文件清单、现有硬编码位置、origin/backup remote 与 TASK/REPORT。
I.value_en: SOP, release checklist, twelve-class file inventory, existing hardcoded locations, origin/backup remotes and TASK/REPORT.
I.notes_en: Actual remote state is not verified.

O.value_zh: 12类发版文件清单、升级的 checklist/SOP、TASK/REPORT 双发归档及三方 SHA 一致记录。
O.value_en: Twelve-class release-file inventory, upgraded checklist/SOP, TASK/REPORT dual-push archive and three-party SHA consistency record.

A.value_zh: 新建 inventory、升级 checklist 和 SOP，运行扫描/readlint，commit 后 push origin/main、backup main 与 backup tags，归档双发。
A.value_en: Create inventory, upgrade checklist and SOP, run scan/readlint, then after commit push origin/main, backup main and backup tags, and dual-push archive.
A.notes_en: Adjudication does not edit or push.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 给出三条红线；ME 执行。
P.value_en: ADMIN supplies three redlines; ME executes.
P.notes_zh: 不从角色推导双远端权限。
P.notes_en: No dual-remote authority inferred from role.

R.value_zh: P0、中风险、12类、6字段、§G 六条扫描、三方 SHA 一致；无截止时间。
R.value_en: P0, medium risk, 12 classes, six fields, §G six scans, three-party SHA equality; no deadline.
R.notes_zh: 严格性要求不增加未列范围。
R.notes_en: Rigor requirement adds no unlisted scope.

V.value_en: Rule 0.c, SOP §§C/G/stage4.5, TASK-012/REPORT-012 and FCoP front-matter rule.

C.value_zh: 12类6字段清单、四硬约束、SOP 行号精确化、ReadLints 与六扫描、origin/backup/tags 双发及 SHA 记录、归档完成。
C.value_en: 12-class six-field inventory, four hard constraints, precise SOP lines, ReadLints/six scans, origin/backup/tags dual pushes with SHA record, and archive completion.

B.value_zh: 不得用 `git push backup --mirror` 或 force 覆盖；不得把精确路径改为通配符；不得省略 backup 同步。
B.value_en: Do not use `git push backup --mirror` or force overwrite; do not replace precise paths with wildcards; do not omit backup synchronization.
B.notes_zh: backup 是发版完成条件的一部分。
B.notes_en: Backup is part of release completion.
